selection: Best loss on a fixed seed sample of 64 development examples; no selection on the user probes.

release_gate.all_three_user_regressions: Greeting is an appropriate greeting; capabilities question describes relevant assistance without claiming live lookup; grant response states both up to 70% and maximum 40 million KRW without invented conditions.
release_gate.heldout_public_qa: At least 6 of 8 answers must answer the specific question with all required facts and no unsupported factual claims. Development documents were excluded from this SFT training, not necessarily from pretraining.
release_gate.termination: All three user regression answers must stop on EOS within 128 output tokens.
release_gate.decision: Do not deploy on loss reduction alone. No automatic activation. Record human-readable assessment of actual generated outputs.
